title: MP Congress protests in Bhopal over detention of Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi and alleged electoral fraud
seoTitle: Bhopal protest over Gandhi detention, EC

tea.why: MP Congress protested the detention of Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi in Delhi and alleged electoral fraud by the BJP.
tea.want: Protesters demanded the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and greater transparency from the Election Commission regarding electoral rolls.
tea.changed: Oct 6: Delhi police detained Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, and other opposition MPs, who were later released.

summary: The Madhya Pradesh unit of the Congress party protested outside the Election Commission office in Bhopal on October 6. Led by state president Jitu Patwari and Leader of Opposition Umang Singhar, the demonstration was in response to the detention of Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra in New Delhi. Protesters raised slogans against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and the BJP, also burning an effigy of CEC Kumar. The party alleged electoral fraud and demanded Kumar's resignation and greater transparency from the Election Commission.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Action on alleged irregularities in electoral rolls
Greater transparency from the Election Commission
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Madhya Pradesh Congress staged a protest outside the Election Commission office in Bhopal.
Protesters burned an effigy of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar during the demonstration.
MP Congress president Jitu Patwari stated the party would burn effigies of PM Modi and CEC Kumar in every district.
